**q22.** dispatcher — `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:156`; it funnels into `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `:47`); delivery package — `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` → `Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, `:120`); signing — Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over `id.timestamp.body` with a `whsec_<base64>` secret, sent as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:97-152`).

**q23.**
- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33` (plus `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go:35`
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198`
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79` (`Memo`, `MemoSchema` at :204)

**q24.**
- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178` (`useCreateMemo`)
- `web/src/connect.ts:181` (`memoServiceClient`)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21` (`CreateMemo`)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`; Connect entry at `connect_services.go:307`)
- `store/memo.go:109` (`Store.CreateMemo`)
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (`DB.CreateMemo`, the `INSERT INTO memo`)

**q25.** Engine: CEL (`cel-go`) in the `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (entry `filter.DefaultEngine()`), with `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `schema.go`, `render.go`. Mechanism: the handler appends `request.Filter` (plus shortcut filters) to `store.FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:215,223`); each dialect driver then calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect<X>, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`), which compiles CEL → dialect-agnostic IR → dialect-specific SQL fragment + placeholder args in `internal/filter/render.go`.

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus child comment memo rows), `memo_relation`, `attachment` (rows + underlying file/blob storage). `memo_share` rows go away only via the schema's `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql:101-108`) — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade does not fire on SQLite. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`) but are never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware`).

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — one `RunOnce` at startup, then a `time.NewTicker` every 12 h (`server/server.go:162-171`; `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-41`)

That is the only background runner started. Unused infra:
- `internal/scheduler` (cron/job scheduler with `job.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) is not referenced anywhere outside its own package/tests.
- `server/runner/memopayload.Runner`/`NewRunner`/`RunOnce` is never started; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (attached to the Connect transport at `:176`). Tokens: a short-lived JWT access token held in `localStorage` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (`web/src/auth-state.ts:52-95`), refreshed against an HttpOnly refresh-token cookie `memos_refresh` sent with `credentials: "include"` (`web/src/connect.ts:57-80`; cookie name `server/auth/token.go:49`); the backend additionally accepts Personal Access Tokens (`memos_pat_` prefix). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`, `extract.go`), invoked via `NewAuthInterceptor`/`Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213` and `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`.

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called `memo_service.go:156`)
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:20` (called `memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:25` (called `memo_service.go:561`)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:30` (called `memo_service_comments.go:119`)

The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120` for delivery.
